messages.subject: prevent R from rounding numbers
parts:
Im working with some GPS data and i want to print it to a file in a specific format.
I found that it's a bit harder then i thought.

> head(data)
            POINT_DATA_ID                       X                       Y
1 10580.00000000000000000 34.82300000000000039790 32.07201099999999627244
2 10583.00000000000000000 34.82609800000000177533 32.07452599999999875990
3 10586.00000000000000000 34.81979899999999616966 32.07986199999999854526
4 10589.00000000000000000 34.82371200000000044383 32.07462100000000049249
5 10592.00000000000000000 34.82397600000000181808 32.07461299999999937427
6 10595.00000000000000000 34.82305300000000158889 32.07218900000000161299
> head(paste(data$X,data$Y))
[1] "34.823 32.072011"    "34.826098 32.074526" "34.819799 32.079862" "34.823712 32.074621" "34.823976 32.074613" "34.823053 32.072189"
> head(sprintf("%f %f",data$X,data$Y))
[1] "34.823000 32.072011" "34.826098 32.074526" "34.819799 32.079862" "34.823712 32.074621" "34.823976 32.074613" "34.823053 32.072189"
> options(digits=22)
> head(sprintf("%f %f",data$X,data$Y))
[1] "34.823000 32.072011" "34.826098 32.074526" "34.819799 32.079862" "34.823712 32.074621" "34.823976 32.074613" "34.823053 32.072189"
> head(paste(data$X,data$Y))
[1] "34.823 32.072011"    "34.826098 32.074526" "34.819799 32.079862" "34.823712 32.074621" "34.823976 32.074613" "34.823053 32.072189"

As you can see, when ever I paste/print the data R rounds it to 6 digits. even after setting digits=22 (the max) i cant make it print right. 

This is pretty stupid. Appreciate any help here. 

Haki.
